description: This file defines the VacancySummaryModel class in the OrangeHRM system's recruitment API module. It models a summary representation of a job vacancy, implementing serialization and normalization functionalities, and setting up entity and filter configurations.
published: Representation of vacancy summary data for API responses

classes.name: VacancySummaryModel
